server.name: flat_detector_private
server.note: The first four tools are read-only and safe to expose to analyst_readonly. request_listing_recheck is separate owner-only opt-in; tool annotations never replace backend authorization.

tools.name: list_active_listings
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of currently verified matching apartments from the server database without fetching external pages.

max_price_rub.description: Maximum price in RUB, never above the administrator limit of 9000000.

availability.description: Require direct or indirect positive verification. If omitted, include both.

page_size.description: Number of saved listings per page.

cursor.description: Opaque server-provided pagination token; omit for the first page.

tools.name: get_listing_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve an existing apartment's normalized facts, source links, availability evidence, and provenance from the database.

listing_id.description: UUID of an already-stored apartment; never accepts arbitrary URLs.

tools.name: get_source_health
tools.description: Retrieve permitted source status, latest successful scans, blocked reasons, and compliance gates without exposing credentials.

source_id.description: Optional registered source identifier; omit to retrieve all readable sources.

tools.name: preview_daily_digest
tools.description: Retrieve a preview of the saved daily apartment digest without sending any Telegram messages or accessing private subscriber data.

local_day.description: Requested digest calendar date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

max_price_rub.description: Optional price cap applied only to an anonymous/owner preview.

tools.name: request_listing_recheck
tools.description: Queue one policy-permitted recheck of an existing saved listing for the authenticated owner after explicit confirmation; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or send messages.

listing_id.description: UUID of a previously stored listing whose source has a currently permitted automatic retrieval mode.

confirmed.description: Owner explicitly confirms this bounded action; server checks role separately.

reason.description: Human-readable purpose of recheck; logged after sanitization.

idempotency_key.description: Unique UUID for safely retrying the request without creating repeated jobs.
